techcrunch.title: Investors sue Selena Gomez alleging fraud tied to her mental health startup
techcrunch.description: The plaintiffs say they invested nearly $1.2 million in the company, and are accusing Gomez of failing to build and market the startup.

techcrunch.title: Flock says its new tool will help identify police abuse, but hasn’t explained how it works
techcrunch.description: The surveillance company announced it's making a tool called "Audit Assistance" mandatory for all customers, claiming it's already helped catch abuse. But the company has yet to explain how the tool works in detail, raising questions about its effectiveness.

techcrunch.title: If Apple sends you a push notification alerting you to a spyware attack, take it seriously
techcrunch.description: Apple now sends out push notifications to iPhone lock screens when the company identifies government spyware targeting someone's devices.

techcrunch.title: Writer introduces new AI model and upgraded harness to contain token costs
techcrunch.description: Built as a post-training variation on Z.ai's open source model GLM-5.2, Writer says the new system should provide deployment-ready capabilities at a much lower price.

techcrunch.title: Databricks wanted to raise $1B, investors wanted $15B. It settled on $5B at a $190B valuation.
techcrunch.description: AI is expensive, Ali Ghodsi tells TechCrunch. With so many investors wanting into his latest round, he said yes to more than planned.

techcrunch.title: OpenAI introduces ‘Ultrafast,’ a new mode that makes GPT-5.6 Sol work at 14x the speed
techcrunch.description: OpenAI is launching a preview of a sped up version of its latest, most powerful model, in an effort to court enterprise users.

techcrunch.title: IBM partners with OpenAI to bolster enterprise AI push
techcrunch.description: IBM plans to train and certify tens of thousands of consultants on OpenAI's technologies as part of this deal.

techcrunch.title: Anthropic set AI agents loose on the same task. They started a turf war.
techcrunch.description: Anthropic researchers found AI agents can clash, collude, and coordinate in unexpected ways, raising new questions about whether today’s safety tests capture the risks of multi-agent systems.

techcrunch.title: OpenAI hires new CRO as executive shake-up continues
techcrunch.description: OpenAI has replaced chief revenue officer Denise Dresser after just nine months on the job, tapping Wiz president and chief operating officer Dali Rajic to take on frontier lab's top sales job.

techcrunch.title: Ford on track to complete $2B factory overhaul for Fathom EV truck
techcrunch.description: Ford expects to begin prototype builds of the Fathom EV in the first quarter of 2027.

techcrunch.title: X open sources its ranking algorithm, letting users see if they’ve been ‘shadowbanned’
techcrunch.description: X is expanding the open source code behind its 'For You' feed and launching new transparency tools that show users when its ranking systems have affected their accounts or posts.

techcrunch.title: Instagram introduces a redesigned wordmark
techcrunch.description: The social media giant says it was time for a sharper and more modern look after a decade.

techcrunch.title: Microsoft kills off unsuccessful AI features while merging its separate Copilot apps
techcrunch.description: Microsoft is simplifying Copilot by combining its consumer and business apps, and dropping AI-generated podcasts, Group Chats, Deep Research, and its Mico character.

techcrunch.title: Nvidia’s new $500B plan is risky but brilliant, especially for aging GPUs
techcrunch.description: Nvidia has a plan to make sure its GPUs won't lose value. It wants to convince a new crop of financiers to keep lending for AI buildouts.

techcrunch.title: Who really needs a cocktail robot?
techcrunch.description: Bartesian's cocktail makers would be best described like a Keurig or Nespresso machine, but for alcoholic drinks.

techcrunch.title: Apple in talks to pay publishers to provide Siri with current news: report
techcrunch.description: The tech giant has considered a nine-figure budget for the payments, according to the WSJ.

techcrunch.title: In a first, US will allow some private firms to carry out cyberattacks
techcrunch.description: The new order sweeps away decades of existing U.S. cybersecurity policy prohibiting private companies from conducting 'hack back' attacks or offensive cyber operations.

techcrunch.title: Can social media start over? Bluesky’s CEO and COO deliver their case at TechCrunch Disrupt 2026
techcrunch.description: Bluesky CEO Toni Schneider is joined by COO Rose Wang for a Disrupt Stage session on whether social media can start over and where Bluesky fits into that potential reboot.

techcrunch.title: Some Claude users are mad that Anthropic’s new watermarks will catch them using it at their jobs, classes
techcrunch.description: Is Anthropic's new watermarking system a travesty? Some have taken to social media to complain that it is.

techcrunch.title: AI nuclear power firm Fermi finally has a new CEO
techcrunch.description: Lee McIntire, an independent member of Fermi's board, has been hired as CEO, more than three months since the company fired co-founder Toby Neugebauer from the top post.
